title: Melody Ranch
paragraphs: Gene Autry western musical-variety series combining songs, comedy and a dramatic Western segment. The frozen GRH container is broader than the historical series: 51 full/near-full Melody Ranch broadcasts, one first-half fragment, five Melody Roundup programs from a separate AFRS/syndicated series, and six later Gene Autry interview items.

GRH documents the program through Pilot (December 31, 1939 to December 31, 1939) on [[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]], First CBS run (January 7, 1940 to August 1, 1943) on [[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]], Postwar 15-minute return (September 23, 1945 to June 16, 1946) on [[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]], and Postwar 30-minute run (June 17, 1946 to December 31, 1955) on [[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]].

Among the most extensively documented contributors in the GRH holdings are Gene Autry (performer on 4 recordings), Johnny Bond (performer on 4 recordings), The Cass County Boys (performer on 4 recordings), The King Sisters (performer on 4 recordings), William Burch (director on 4 recordings), Carl Cotner and His Orchestra (performer on 3 recordings), and Carl Cotner (performer on 1 recording).
The program is also connected in the archive to [[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]] (broadcast on network).

Its indexed subjects and listening characteristics include country-western and cowboy music, Western adventure and ranch storytelling, Gene Autry career interview and retrospective, Melody Roundup / AFRS country-western programming, religious and inspirational music, and Christmas and holiday programming.

GRH also places the series in documented historical contexts including Wartime interruption and Gene Autry’s Army Air Forces service, CBS commercial Western-variety sponsorship, Singing-cowboy popular culture, and Post-series Gene Autry retrospective archive.

Programs with especially strong personnel connections in the GRH knowledge graph include [[show|barrie-craig|Barrie Craig]] (1 shared credited people), [[show|boston-blackie|Boston Blackie]] (1 shared credited people), [[show|columbia-workshop|Columbia Workshop]] (1 shared credited people), [[show|sears-radio-theater|Sears Radio Theater]] (1 shared credited people), and [[show|the-adventures-of-the-thin-man|The Adventures of the Thin Man]] (1 shared credited people).
